name: @perscope/bridge
description: Local message-relay bridge for the PerScope Chrome extension: paired WebSocket to the extension + MCP server (stdio via proxy, streamable-HTTP) for agents. Zero logic — relays only.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/pairing.test.js test/lockfile.test.js test/ws-auth.test.js test/agent-mux.test.js test/roundtrip.test.js test/stdio-purity.test.js
